title: Ash on the Wind
summary: Wren is stranded on a ledge above land where the skeletons wear scorched cloaks. She needs a way down and some bones for the rope.
ask: Wren: Don't come up! Stay down there! Actually, do come up, but quietly.
Wren: The archers below keep shooting at anyone who moves. I need a way off this ledge and you look like someone who has a plan.

done: Wren: You made it! Good. Now there are archers between us and the road.

start: An arrow thumps into the rock beside your hand. Then three more.
done: The last of them folds up like a deckchair. The wind stops carrying arrows.

steps.text: Gather six bones for the rope
done: Wren: Perfect. Strong, dry, and the right length. Don't ask what it was before.
Wren: Rope's done. I'm going down first, no arguments.
Wren: Here. Something for the climb, and the company.
